digest.component_or_area: Reconcile Bridge git delivery and push retry logic
propositions: Bridge git push fails with TLS/DNS/timeout errors and is abandoned after one attempt rather than retried, losing converged work on the runner
push.py treats all non-zero push outcomes except non-fast-forward as terminal, conflating permanent policy violations with transient transport faults
merge recovery legs fail with transport errors (certificate verification, promisor fetch failure) and are not retried, raising merge-recovery-blocked instead of handling transient faults

No backoff or retry budget exists for transport failures; the fix requires subtractive classification of retriable transport signatures and bounded retry with exponential backoff (3 attempts max, 0.5s then 2.0s delays)
Policy decline failures must remain terminal at one attempt while transport failures must retry; both currently raise from the same code path
